evals.prompt: Add a global error handler that maps exceptions to ProblemDetail
expect: returns Spring 6 ProblemDetail (RFC 7807), not a hand-rolled body
uses jakarta.* imports (Spring Boot 3.x), not javax
handles MethodArgumentNotValidException, NotFoundException, and a fallback Exception

evals.prompt: Map validation errors to a 400 ProblemDetail with field details
expect: MethodArgumentNotValidException is handled and returns HTTP 400
the body includes a per-field errors map built from getFieldErrors()

evals.prompt: Make sure a 404 is returned when a resource is not found
expect: a domain NotFoundException maps to HTTP 404
reuses an existing NotFoundException if the project already has one

evals.prompt: Add a fallback handler for unexpected errors that doesn't leak internals
expect: the response does not include a stack trace or ex.getMessage()
the error is logged server-side instead

evals.prompt: Add a global error handler but the project already has a @RestControllerAdvice
expect: extends/adds to the existing advice instead of creating a competing one
shows a diff before modifying the existing handler

evals.prompt: Detect the base package before generating the error handler
expect: places GlobalExceptionHandler in the web package next to existing controllers
does not invent a package or use javax.* / Spring 5 APIs
